title: Is there an AI-powered voice trading journal?
author: I1Youni
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I'm wondering if there's any trading journal that allows you to record a trade simply by sending a voice note, with AI automatically extracting the relevant information and organising it into structured journal entries.

Does anything like this already exist? I'd appreciate any recommendations!

comments.author: tradematesHQ
comments.body: Voice notes sound cool but you'll never review them. The journal only works if you actually reread entries, and text search beats scrolling audio. Just type it, takes 30 seconds.
